events.text_en: An old fisher who belongs to no sect forms his core sitting by a hole in the Liên Giang ice.
Băng Tâm's licence to the fishers of Liên Giang: they may sit as Hàn Giang sat, on Water alone; Ice belongs to the Pavilion.
Lãnh Giang's co-founder goes through the spring ice sitting the seventh layer; the school never sits on spring ice again.
